Container.Name: PlayTracker
Container.Overview: Self-hosted game playtime and session tracker. Steam, Xbox and PlayStation only report lifetime playtime, so PlayTracker snapshots it on a schedule (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly or every X days) and turns the difference into play sessions. Includes stats, heatmaps, year in review, cross-platform duplicate handling, history import that keeps your charts accurate, a REST API, webhooks and a mobile-friendly PWA.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for daily stats and scheduled sync times

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the UI and API (can also be set in Settings)

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when served over HTTPS (reverse proxy)

Config.Name: CORS origin
Config.Description: Allow browser API calls from another origin (e.g. a dashboard)
